Shi et al. in "Distilled Low Rank Neural Radiance Field with Quantization for Light Field Compression" [S1, unofficial].

The claim accurately reflects the content of Source [S1]. The source explicitly states that Shi et al. propose a method involving 'Distilled Low Rank Neural Radiance Field' (DLR-NeRF) for light field compression. It details the process of transferring knowledge from LR-NeRF to DLR-NeRF by decomposing low-rank weight tensors into Tensor Train (TT) components ($W^r_i = Q1_i Q2_i$), initializing the new network with these components (and biases), and using this structure to bridge low-rank approximation and quantization. All specific facts mentioned in the claim are present in the provided notes and passages.
